C0189.title: CCTV 3·15 Gala Exposes Cloud-Controlled Systems Artificially Inflating Livestream Engagement
C0189.summary: The 2023 CCTV 3·15 Gala exposed companies including Shaanxi Yarunjin Network Technology Co., Ltd. for providing cloud-controlled systems capable of bulk liking, inflating viewer counts, and boosting online presence in livestreams. The practice creates a false sense of popularity through technical means, misleading consumers and distorting platform algorithms.
